task_reconstruction.official_task: 2023 MCM Problem C, Wordle reports: the trend, the hard-mode share, the try distribution, and the difficulty of words.
required_outputs: an explanation of the report count and a forecast for March 1, 2023
a test of whether word attributes change the hard-mode share
a predicted try distribution for EERIE
a difficulty label for EERIE and the attributes that drive it
a letter to the editors of the puzzle

section_map.summary: summary: five models, each with its own adverb
background and the task list, ending on an open item
assumptions that may later be relaxed
three outliers corrected, and a logarithm defended
the forecast built from four named terms
the player groups, with no equation printed
a regression that fails its test
a network whose outputs are clipped and rescaled
three clusters, then a letter test
a letter that corrects the reader's belief

contributions.summary: The forecast multiplies four named terms and is fit on the log count.
The word attributes do not explain the hard-mode share.
Words fall into three difficulty groups from their try shares.
Words starting with e, f, and w are called hard, and words starting with t easy.

dependency_graph.label: The trend is what the player groups explain.
The attributes move to the network.
The try shares are what the clustering sorts.
The labels motivate the letter test.

assumptions.summary: Twitter users are essentially constant in number, and each is equally likely to see a report.
Every player is a Twitter user, and every Twitter user might play.
The daily word is completely random.
A player may tire of the game and later return.
Ordinary users start playing with probability lambda, players tire with probability beta, and tired players return with probability eta.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Three outliers, tash, clen, and rprobe, are corrected to trash, clean, and probe.
Eighteen of thirty-six part-of-speech tags are kept, and seventeen dummy variables are built.
The report count is logged to reduce heteroscedasticity.
Five word attributes are defined, and the letter-frequency sum is written as a formula.

models.summary: MU-C-Q256-001: the trend, the season, the holidays, and the product.
MU-C-Q256-002: the three player groups, with no equation printed.
MU-C-Q256-003: the hard-mode line and its F test.
MU-C-Q256-004: the network, the clipping, and the rescaling.
MU-C-Q256-006: the binomial test on the first letter.

verification.summary: March 1, 2023 is forecast at 14534, with an interval from 13175 to 16128.
The hard-mode line has F of 1.058 and p of 0.379.
The network has a mean absolute error of 3.2302 on the test set.

results_trace.summary: The report count is said to be falling.
Word attributes do not change the hard-mode share.
EERIE is predicted as 0, 6, 18, 29, 27, 15, and 5 percent across the seven bins.
The letters e, f, and w are called hard, and t is called easy.
mummy ranks second by the share of players who need five or more tries, at 82 percent.

The reader is told what they probably believe, and then corrected.
